Question: A parabola with equation \(y = ax^2 + bx + c\) is reflected about the \(x\)-axis. The parabola and its reflection are translated horizontally five units in opposite directions to become the graphs of \(y = f(x)\) and \(y = g(x),\) respectively. Which of the following describes the graph of \(y = (f + g)(x)?\)

Choices.B: a parabola not tangent to the \(x\)-axis
Choices.E: the graph of a cubic function
